12	  failed attempt's copy (`scheduler.rs:7611-7612`, `OWNER_ROUND_HEADING`).

14	  (`scheduler.rs:10534`) keeps only `Complete` attempts, so failed
15	  `review/1` is skipped and `plan/1`'s copy is reviewed
16	  (`facts.md` Settled, root cause). The plan fixes the choice of source
17	  and leaves the note where it is.
18	- **The issue frames the loss as a post-`revise` problem.** The rule is
19	  wider: a review edits its copy in place under one path from the first
20	  round (`docs/design.md:2215`), so any failed attempt's copy is newer
21	  than the plan stage's, with or without a `revise`. The plan applies to
22	  every failed review attempt, not only ones with
23	  `Attempt.revisions` (`ticket.rs:350`) non-empty. It does not apply to
24	  cancelled ones: the tree sets `Cancelled` for a ticket close
25	  (`scheduler.rs:2914`), a stop with a reason (`scheduler.rs:2872`) and a
26	  send-back (`scheduler.rs:4962`, `scheduler.rs:5585`, reason prefixed
27	  `SENT_BACK_FROM`, l.8979), where the owner discarded the attempt on
28	  purpose, and the facts file settles only failed attempts.
29	- **Step 2 of the repro (a runner restart gives `review run gone`).**
30	  Not borne out or contradicted: it is Unresolved U2 and owner question
31	  O1. `Paused{failed:true}` (`scheduler.rs:7840`) fails the attempt the
32	  same way, so the plan does not depend on the cause.
33	- **"Say which copy it will review" in `show`.** `show` lists only
34	  `Complete` or open attempts (`Ticket::shown_where`, `ticket.rs:1476`),
35	  so a failed copy is listed nowhere. The plan records where a rerun
36	  started from (below) rather than rediscovering it from files.
37	
38	## The record
39	
40	One additive field, `Attempt.started_from: Option<(String, u32)>`
41	(`ticket.rs:266`, `#[serde(default)]`): the `(stage, n)` of the attempt
42	whose copy this workflow attempt was started from. Set in
43	`start_workflow` for every workflow attempt; a plan review's first
44	attempt names the plan stage's attempt, a rerun names the failed
45	review attempt. Why a field and not a recomputation at display time:
46	the choice depends on whether a file existed when the attempt started,
47	and `show` should report what happened, not what the rule would pick
48	now. Attempts already running keep `None` and `show` says nothing about
49	them.
50	
51	Version: `RECORD_VERSION` (`store.rs:26`) at implementation time, plus
52	one. Add the matching step comment in `migrate` (`store.rs:450`,
53	after the "27 to 28" step at l.608) in the same style: an attempt
54	gains `started_from`, absent from its serde default, nothing is
55	transformed, a build that would drop it must refuse the record. The
56	version today is 28; take whatever the file says when you start, since a
57	parallel ticket may have taken 29.
58	
59	## The signals
60	
61	None new. No hook event, no wire message: `Body::WorkflowStart.plan`
62	(`scheduler.rs:7519`) already carries the copy's path, and the app
63	reviews whatever file it is given. The app is not changed.
64	
65	## The actions and effects
66	
67	No new `AppAction`, `Effect`, port or adapter; the change is inside the
68	runner's `start_workflow` path.
69	
70	1. **Choose the source** (`scheduler.rs:10534`). Change
71	   `review_subject(t, subject)` to
72	   `review_subject(t, stage, ctx, subject, exists)` returning a small
73	   struct `Subject { path, session, from: (String, u32) }` instead of a
74	   tuple (it now has three parts, and a tuple of `PathBuf, String, (String, u32)` is hard to read). `exists` is
75	   `impl Fn(&Path) -> bool` so the function stays testable without a
76	   disk (a closure parameter: the caller passes `Path::exists`, a test
77	   passes `|_| true`).
78	   - **Session**: unchanged. The newest `Complete` attempt that wrote
79	     `subject`, its `session`, with the same two errors ("nothing wrote
80	     …", "… was not written by a session"). A review attempt's own
81	     `session` is the planner/reviewer face (`scheduler.rs:7777-7781`),
82	     so the clone source must stay the plan stage's session; path and
83	     session no longer come from one attempt.
84	   - **Path**: the newest attempt of `(stage, ctx)` with kind `Workflow`
85	     and state `Failed`, *positioned after* that `Complete` writer in
86	     `t.attempts`, whose `artifacts[subject]` exists. Else the
87	     `Complete` writer's path. The position test is what stops a failed
88	     `review/1` from beating a `plan/2` that was written after a
89	     send-back. `Cancelled` does not qualify: every `Cancelled` write in
90	     the tree (`scheduler.rs:2872`, `2914`, `4962`, `5585`) is an owner
91	     stop, close or send-back, so a cancelled copy is not one the owner
92	     wants reviewed, and a review cancelled by a later stage's send-back
93	     with no new `plan` attempt would otherwise win. Widening to cancel
94	     reasons that are not `SENT_BACK_FROM…` is a follow-up that needs a
95	     line in the tree showing such a copy is wanted.
96	   - **Missing file**: falls back to the plan stage's copy
97	     (`facts.md` Settled: nothing removes the `artifacts` entry, but
98	     nothing checks the file either).
99	   - `start_workflow` (`scheduler.rs:7465`) passes
100	     `&stage.name, ctx, &subject, Path::exists`, copies from
101	     `subject.path` as now (l.7474-7477) and sets
102	     `started_from = Some(subject.from)` on the attempt it pushes
103	     (l.7499). `new_attempt` (`scheduler.rs:10277`) initialises `None`.
104	   - Chained failures work: `review/3` starts from `review/2`'s copy,
105	     which was itself started from `review/1`'s.
106	2. **Say it in the rerun question.** `rerun_carries`
107	   (`scheduler.rs:9382`) returns `&'static str` and is empty for a
108	   workflow attempt. Make it return `String`; its two callers are
109	   `fail_attempt_with` (l.7266) and `rerun_ask` (l.9373). For a
110	   `Workflow` attempt whose `artifacts` holds a copy, it computes the
111	   source with the same `review_subject` call (subject name = the
112	   attempt's one artifact key, as `plan_rounds` does in `serve.rs`) and
113	   appends: " A rerun reviews {path}" plus, when that is the failed
114	   attempt's own copy, " (this attempt's copy, {n} revision(s) by the
115	   owner; the planner may have been mid-edit)", else " (the plan stage's
116	   output; this attempt's copy is missing)". The finalize question
117	   already names its copy the same way (`review_done`,
118	   `scheduler.rs:7692-7695`). Both the first ask and the re-ask after a
119	   park go through these two callers, so both carry the text.
120	3. **The default does not depend on the unresolved facts.** U1 (a
121	   half-written revised copy when `no such run` arrives) and O1 (what
122	   caused the loss) are answered by the same behaviour: the rerun
123	   starts from the newest copy and the question says which one and
124	   how many revisions it holds, so the owner can open it and answer
125	   `park` instead. No branch tests the cause. Nothing is built behind
126	   the default.
127	
128	## The UI
129	
130	`show` only; the Plan tab in the app is not changed.
131	
132	- `dispatch-control/src/lib.rs:586` `LaneFile` gains
133	  `started_from: Option<PathBuf>`, the source copy's path. The struct
134	  is `#[serde(default)]` and derives `Default`, so an older runner's
135	  JSON reads as `None` (`facts.md` Settled; that the Plan tab ignores
136	  the field rests on serde ignoring unknown fields, which this plan
137	  assumes and the UI test below confirms for the struct's
138	  deserialisation, not for the tab's drawing).
139	- `serve.rs:538` `ticket_paths`: when the shown attempt has
140	  `started_from == Some((stage, n))` with `stage == a.stage` (a rerun),
141	  set the field to that attempt's `artifacts` path, found with
142	  `find_attempt` (`scheduler.rs:9452`). A first attempt leaves it `None`
143	  so a normal review prints nothing new.
144	- `main.rs:896` `print_lane_files`: after the existing
145	  "(reviewed copy, round N, review open)" line, print
146	  "(started from the previous attempt's copy: {path}; its owner rounds
147	  stay beside it)" when the field is set. That names the reviewed copy
148	  (already marked) and the prior revision, which the issue asked for.
149	  If the file has no capture test, move the line text into a function
150	  returning `String` and test that.
151	
152	## The tests
153	
154	Scheduler (`scheduler.rs` tests, beside the review-plan-input tests at
155	~l.12838-12869; read the fake that answers `Body::Workflow` there
156	first — `facts.md` could not say which harness answers it):
157	
158	- `review_subject` unit tests with `|_| true`: a failed `review/1`
159	  after `plan/1` gives `review/1`'s path, `plan/1`'s session and
160	  `from == ("review", 1)`; two failed attempts give the newer; a
161	  `Cancelled` one does not (including one with a `SENT_BACK_FROM`
162	  reason, newest after `plan/1`: the result is `plan/1`); an open one
163	  does not; a `plan/2` `Complete`
164	  after the failed `review/1` gives `plan/2`; the exists closure
165	  returning false gives `plan/1`; no `Complete` writer is still the
166	  "nothing wrote" error.
167	- The gate (`facts.md` U3): seed a ticket with `plan/1` complete, a
168	  failed `review/1` whose copy differs and whose `revisions` is
169	  non-empty, a `rerun` answer acted (`may_rerun`, l.10665); run the
170	  runner pass; assert the `WorkflowStart.plan` sent is under
171	  `review/2`, its content equals `review/1`'s copy, `source` is
172	  `plan/1`'s session, and the new attempt's `started_from` is
173	  `Some(("review", 1))`. A second case with `plan/1` only asserts the
174	  old behaviour and `started_from == Some(("plan", 1))`.
175	- If the fake allows it, a test that answers `Reply::Failed { reason:
176	  NO_SUCH_RUN.into() }` to `Body::Workflow` (no existing test does,
177	  `facts.md` Q on fakes), asserts the attempt becomes `Failed` with
178	  "review run gone", the `rerun` question names `review/1`'s copy, and
179	  the next pass starts from it. If the fake cannot, say so in the
180	  commit and keep the seeded gate.
181	- `rerun_ask` text: workflow attempt names the path and revision count;
182	  a code review attempt's text and the `resolution` text are unchanged
183	  (`events.rs` rerun tests ~l.3313 pin neighbours; update only if they
184	  fail on the new text).
185	
186	Store (`store.rs` tests near l.971): a record at the previous version
187	loads with `started_from == None` and is written at the new version.
188	
189	Serve and control: `ticket_paths` on a ticket with `review/1` failed and
190	`review/2` open sets `LaneFile.started_from` to `review/1`'s copy;
191	with `review/1` open it is `None`. `dispatch-control`: JSON for a
192	`LaneFile` without the field deserialises.
193	
194	Then `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets
195	-- -D warnings`, `cargo test --locked --workspace`.
196	
197	## Docs and changelog
198	
199	- `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased, under Fixed: "A Dispatch plan review rerun
200	  after a failed attempt starts from that attempt's copy of the plan,
201	  with the owner's revisions, instead of the plan stage's original; the
202	  rerun question and `show` say which copy it reviews."
203	- `docs/design.md`: the runner-patience paragraph (l.1782-1786, "a
204	  rerun kills the old run's agents and starts a fresh run") gains "from
205	  the newest copy a failed attempt held"; add the status line to the
206	  "Plan review workflow" section (l.1000) with the `started_from` field
207	  and the record version.
208	- `README.md`: no new file, env var or data-directory entry, so no
209	  change to the Layout table or dev aids.
210	- The app is unchanged, the app/script `SWITCHBOARD_SCRIPT` has nothing
211	  to reach, and `Ticket::input`/`lane_input` still hand later stages
212	  only `Complete` plans on purpose (pinned at `scheduler.rs:12838`).
213	
214	## Follow-ups for the owner (not in this plan)
215	
216	- O1: whether the real ticket's revised copy was complete and whether a
217	  runner or app restart caused `no such run`. If the app drops runs on
218	  restart, that is its own bug; this plan makes the loss harmless, not
219	  rare. The answer changes nothing here.
220	- The app's Plan tab could show the `started_from` marker; the tab was
221	  not read.
222	- The planner clone in a rerun is cloned from the plan stage's
223	  conversation, so it has not seen the owner's `revise` note as a
224	  message, only its effect in the copy. Handing it the note is a
225	  separate decision.
226	
227	## Commit
228	
229	`Dispatch: a plan review rerun starts from the failed attempt's copy and says so`
230	
231	Contract additions (copy into the commit message):
232	
233	- `Attempt.started_from: Option<(String, u32)>` (`dispatch/src/ticket.rs`), serde default.
234	- `LaneFile.started_from: Option<PathBuf>` (`dispatch-control/src/lib.rs`), serde default.
235	- `RECORD_VERSION` in `dispatch/src/store.rs`: the value there at implementation time, plus one, with a `migrate` comment step.
236	- No new `AppAction`, `Effect`, port method or wire message.
